detect_corners_aruco_markers: detect ArUco marker corners in images using cv2.aruco with subpixel refinement for a target marker index
build_camera_projection_matrix: build a 3x3 camera intrinsic projection matrix from fx, fy, ppx, ppy focal length and principal point parameters
optimize_hand_eye_calibration_parameters: optimize eye-in-hand calibration parameters using LBFGS to minimize reprojection error between observed and projected marker positions
compute_rotation_matrix_from_rotvec: compute a 3x3 rotation matrix from a 3-element rotation vector using skew-symmetric matrix exponential
generate_simulated_calibration_data: generate synthetic eye-in-hand calibration data with configurable noise for a 2-DOF robot arm and camera setup
